post.summary: Latched robot STOP for this Session's runtime identity
post.description: Sends the native latched STOP inside the lifecycle critical section and returns dispatch, parking and coverage evidence separately. It is not POST /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stop, it never RESETs, never clears the safety latch and never ends the recording.

post.summary: Stop and reliably finalize the recording segment this Session began
post.description: Identity-bound end of the Session's own recording segment. The receipt separates STOP dispatch, parking evidence, Recorder drain, finalize proof and episode integrity; a tail file alone is not reported as a complete recording.
